configuration.thermal_path_policy: Nearest underlying modeled sheet; SiO₂-equivalent geometric gaps. Physical contacts/vias replace gap areas; one backside reservoir.
configuration.validation: Generated, not simulated. Convergence and model/mesh acceptance must be established separately.

loss_budget.definition: Disjoint layer-role, interface and external-feed integrals; groups are views, not additional losses

acceptance_errors: A required level has no converged model-valid result
